high_level_description: stc brand style, a row of four airplane windows each showing a different Saudi destination, from a desert village to overwater villas, a rock arch, and a hillside town.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A dark airplane cabin interior with four illuminated oval windows in a row, lit with warm dusk tones.

elements.desc: The first window shows a mud-brick desert village at dusk.
The second window shows ring-shaped overwater villas on calm water.
The third window shows a tall natural rock arch formation glowing at dusk.
The fourth window shows a green hillside town with terraced stone buildings.
